counterfactual_missing_items: Explicit term 'carcinoma' is not present in the raw vignette
No mention of capsular or vascular invasion to formally subtype follicular carcinoma
decisive_items: follicular thyroid cells in the goiter and the manubrial lesion
thyroid follicles infiltrating adjacent to bone trabeculae
response.rationale: C2 is the most complete and accurate label: the lytic manubrial lesion plus follicular thyroid cells and infiltrating thyroid follicles in bone indicate metastatic thyroid carcinoma to the manubrium. R5 has the same core diagnosis but omits the manubrium in the label. R1 and C1 are rejected because 'goiter with metastasis' is not a valid malignant diagnosis and is contradicted by infiltrating thyroid follicles in bone.

rejected.why: Labels the process as goiter with metastasis; benign goiters do not metastasize, and infiltrating thyroid follicles in bone indicate carcinoma.
Adds manubrium to the same incorrect goiter-based diagnosis; still misses metastatic thyroid carcinoma.
